bookSourceComment: 66成人小说(66story.com)，MCCMS系统纯文字小说站。发现和搜索使用JSON API /api/data/book 接口。发现页带select切换分类/排行，参考爱丽丝书屋风格。API需带Referer。详情页规则兼容移动版和桌面版。正文混入评论数span已用replaceRegex清理。
exploreUrl:
<js>
var result=[];
var tab=infoMap["分类"]||"分类";
var cats=[["校园春色","cid=3"],["东方玄幻","cid=4"],["乡村爱情","cid=5"],["都市激情","cid=6"],["家庭乱伦","cid=7"],["娱乐明星","cid=8"]];
var ranks=[["人气榜","order=hits"],["收藏榜","order=shits"],["最新更新","order=addtime"]];
result.push({title:"分类",type:"select",chars:["分类","排行"],default:tab,action:"java.refreshExplore()",style:{layout_flexGrow:1,layout_flexBasisPercent:1}});
if(tab=="分类"){for(var i=0;i<cats.length;i++){result.push({title:cats[i][0],url:"/index.php/api/data/book?order=addtime&"+cats[i][1]+"&page={{page}}",style:{layout_flexGrow:1,layout_flexBasisPercent:0.333}})}}else if(tab=="排行"){for(var i=0;i<ranks.length;i++){result.push({title:ranks[i][0],url:"/index.php/api/data/book?"+ranks[i][1]+"&page={{page}}",style:{layout_flexGrow:1,layout_flexBasisPercent:0.333}})}}
JSON.stringify(result);
</js>
